item.title: High latency for the us-east region [investigating]
item.description: Customers may have experienced high latency in API requests from ~4 to 7 AM UTC on 2026-09-11 . The cause appears to be network instability and packet loss in connections from the IAD Cloudflare zone. We are communicating with providers about the issue.
